class: engineering (same algorithm, same relations; native speed only)

baseline_row.description: the landed n=73, K=600 single-target IC row: experiments/koblitz-single-target-n73-20261003 (R1 rank-stage wall 18,398,763 ms, 457,561 target probes, rho/IC online 184.9x)
baseline_row.fixture_sidecar: experiments/koblitz-single-target-n73-20261003/frozen/fixture.json (validation only; never an input to either arm)
baseline_row.note: R1 ran the sequential rank path; the arms here use the documented parallel guided rank (KIC_RANK_THREADS=3), whose per-column scalars differ from R1's, so the relation set and probe counts differ from R1 and the R1 wall is a historical anchor on another host, not an arm.

binaries.ic: target/release/examples/koblitz_orbit_dlp_fast sha256 bd9c3f0dc8c3113ed6ffba4a85bef4249fdfa39d1d3454dff82624ba4767edb4 (source = PR #2156 head 655afd43e + KIC_RANK_TRACE per-column trace, observation only)

arms.O (old producer): KIC_LAZY_CANON=0 KIC_PREFETCH=0, serial index build, KIC_RANK_THREADS=3, same binary
arms.N (landed producer): binary defaults (KIC_LAZY_CANON=1 KIC_PREFETCH=1) + KIC_INDEX_THREADS=3 KIC_INDEX_BATCH_INV=1 (the two opt-in index switches are part of the landed gains), KIC_RANK_THREADS=3, same binary
arms.run_order: scan positive control (3 rounds of old/new), rho draws 1-10, N1, O1, N2, rho draws 11-20
arms.A/A: N1 vs N2 (same arm twice, bracketing O1); no second O run (cost: one old run is about 2 h): drift of O1 is bracketed, not estimated

host: this container: 4 vCPU Xeon 2.80 GHz KVM guest, 15 GiB, no PMU; IC pinned to cores 1-3 and rho to core 1 through tools/isolated_bench.py (core 0 for the system); contended flag recorded per run

metrics.primary: end-to-end cold wall = bash real of the whole process (process start, base load, basis, index build, rank stage, linear algebra, target, exit), ratio O1 / mean(N1,N2)
metrics.uncertainty: bootstrap (10,000 resamples, 95% percentile) over the 600 rank columns stratified by thread class (column mod 3), the same resampled columns in both arms; rank wall = max over strata of summed per-column ns; non-rank phases as measured. Run-to-run noise: the A/A N1/N2 ratio with the same estimator.
secondary: IC/rho wall and cpu with bootstrap over the 20 rho draws
metrics.counted_S: identical by construction (same probes and relations); verified by per-column probe/attempt equality across arms; priced across the 5a band w in {0, 0.1, 1} GAE per native op

verification: every IC arm: targets_solved=1, rank=600, group_verified, recovered scalar equals the sidecar answer; independent replay with examples/t20_replay.rs (own GF(2^73) arithmetic); every rho draw verified=true

controls.positive_scan: 3 interleaved rounds of the 20,000-state scan, old vs new, at the real base: harness must see new/old well below 1 (the engineering note measured 0.38 at K=600 on a loaded guest)
controls.positive_analyzer: N1 columns scaled by 1.10 vs N2 columns: the estimator must report a CI excluding 1 around 1.10
controls.matched_rho: 20 draws, walk seeds 910000001..910000020, same frozen target, same host, interleaved around the IC runs

decision_rules.kill: point estimate of the end-to-end wall ratio O1 / mean(N1,N2) below 1.1 => record that the component gains do not reach the row
decision_rules.support: ratio >= 1.1 and the bootstrap CI lower bound above 1.0 and above the A/A spread
decision_rules.invalid: any arm unverified, outputs not identical across arms, A/A CI excluding 1 with width comparable to the claimed effect, scan positive control not detected

inadmissible: changing K, base, target, seed or switches after timing
dropping a run for being slow
headline wall time without the counted-S statement
